w10_T4_003703: In the morning, Mira started a fundraising jar, and each of her 5 friends put 66 dollars into it. She then divided the jar's money equally into 2 jars and kept only 1 of them, giving the other to the school. The jar is 30 centimetres tall. In the afternoon her neighbour added 35 dollars to Mira's jar, and Mira took out 20 dollars to buy poster paint. In the evening a local business promised to make the jar's contents 4 times as large, and it did. How many dollars are in Mira's jar now?
w10_T4_003704: Kara collected 196 shells on the first day of her beach holiday, more than the 150 that her brother Finn collected. The beach is 3 kilometres long. On the second day she found 22 more shells, and on the third day 28. On the fourth day she found 75 shells, on the fifth day 58, and on the last day just 7. How many shells did Kara collect in total?
w10_T4_003706: A community hall, which is 40 metres long, had 212 folding chairs, and 36 more were donated. The caretaker divided all the chairs equally among 4 rooms. In the blue room, 35 chairs were later found to be broken and were thrown away. The hall then rented out every chair left in the blue room for 6 dollars each for a wedding. The caretaker counts the coins in cents and records the total in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars did the hall earn from renting the blue room's chairs?
w10_T4_003716: An online petition to keep the village library open had 163 signatures, and the library currently opens twice a week. Over the weekend 69 more people signed. The organisers then removed 84 signatures that were duplicates. The petition itself is 3 pages long. After a well-known author shared it, the number of signatures grew to 8 times what it had been. A final check then struck out 818 signatures as invalid. How many signatures does the petition have now?
w10_T4_003725: A small island had a population of 87 wild rabbits. Rangers trapped 76 of them and moved them to the mainland. Over the following year the rabbit population on the island grew to 9 times its size. A harsh winter then killed 95 rabbits. In spring the rangers released 16 rabbits back onto the island. How many rabbits are on the island now?
w10_T4_003734: Ivo and Lea are playing a trading board game. Ivo has 204 coins, more than the 150 coins Lea has. Ivo pays 83 coins in rent and then 73 coins in tax. He lands on a bonus square that multiplies his coins by 5. He then draws a card that makes him divide his coins equally into 2 piles and give 1 pile to the bank. Finally he collects 17 coins for passing the start square. How many coins does Ivo have now?
w10_T4_003741: A printer is preparing a report for a dozen committee members. The main text runs to 226 pages, the appendix adds 25 pages, and the index adds another 43 pages to each copy. She prints 8 complete copies of the report. She also prints 62 cover sheets to wrap the copies. She weighs the paper in grams and records the parcel weight in kilograms, since a thousand grams make one kilogram. How many pages does the printer produce in total?
w10_T4_003743: Tess keeps a jar of buttons, and she sews twice a week. The jar held 99 buttons, and she added 56 buttons from an old coat. She used 102 buttons on a quilt and then found 11 buttons in her sewing box, which has 5 drawers, and dropped them into the jar. She then divided all the buttons in the jar equally into 4 tins and kept only 1 tin for herself. How many buttons are in the tin Tess kept?
w10_T4_003746: A supplier packs 9 candles into each of 46 boxes to fill one order, and a church buys 2 such orders. The church is 200 years old. It shares all the candles equally among 3 chapels. Each candle in the north chapel burns for 2 hours. The verger records burning time in minutes although the candles are sold by the hour, and sixty minutes make one hour. For how many hours in total will the north chapel's candles burn?
w10_T4_003747: In the morning, each of the 7 cashiers at a market started with 220 cents in coins in their float, and all the floats were counted as one pool. During the afternoon 1013 cents from the pool were handed out as change. In the evening a customer paid 63 cents in coins into the pool, and the manager added 19 cents she found on the floor. The market has 4 entrances. The manager writes the pool total in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents are in the coin pool now?
w10_T4_003748: Maya buys 4 packs of batteries with 16 batteries in each pack, and she replaces her torch batteries twice a year. She finds that 3 of the batteries are dead. Each good battery powers her camping lamp for 9 hours. She also has a spare rechargeable pack that gives 41 hours of light. She notes the lamp's running time in minutes on the box, although the packaging lists hours, and sixty minutes make one hour. How many hours of light does Maya have in total?
w10_T4_003749: In the morning, 3 pipes each fed 57 litres of water into the empty village cistern every hour, and they ran for 8 hours. In the afternoon the villagers drew 633 litres from the cistern. In the evening a rain shower added 41 litres. The cistern gauge shows kilolitres, but the warden keeps his log in litres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres are in the cistern now?
w10_T4_003751: In the morning, a bakery had 22 empty trays, and it sent 18 of them to a cafe. The oven was set to 200 degrees. In the afternoon each remaining tray was filled with 9 rolls, and all the rolls were then shared equally among 3 hampers. In the evening 1 roll was taken out of the first hamper and eaten. The bakery prices rolls in cents but writes its bills in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many rolls are in the first hamper now?
w10_T4_003763: Hana collected 132 empty cans for recycling, more than the 100 cans her friend Jun collected. She collected 70 more at the park and 6 at the bus stop. She divided all her cans equally among 4 sacks and kept 1 sack, giving the others to Jun. She then found 3 more cans in her garden and 15 in her garage and put them in her sack. The recycling centre pays in cents, and Hana converts to dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cans are in Hana's sack?
w10_T4_003764: Raj planted 91 tulip bulbs in his garden, which is 12 metres long, more than the 80 bulbs his neighbour Sita planted. Squirrels dug up 55 of Raj's bulbs. Each remaining bulb produced 3 flowers. Sita gave him 23 cut flowers, and another neighbour gave him 11. He sells flowers for cents but writes his takings in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many flowers does Raj have?
w10_T4_003772: In the morning, a bottling line filled 172 bottles of juice, and then a second run of exactly the same size doubled the total. In the afternoon 73 bottles came over from a second line and 71 from a third. In the evening the bottles were sold to a cafe, and each bottle fills 7 glasses, with each glass priced at 3 dollars. How many dollars will the cafe take if it sells every glass?
w10_T4_003778: Lou's gift shop, which is open 8 hours a day, orders 2 crates of mugs with 107 mugs in each crate. On unpacking, 17 mugs are found broken. Lou puts 3 price stickers on every remaining mug, and he also has 14 spare stickers. Each sticker costs him 6 cents. How many cents did Lou spend on the stickers he used and the spares together?
w10_T4_003787: Ida had 93 cents in her pocket, more than the 80 cents her friend Bo had. She spent 49 cents on an apple. Her mother gave her 53 cents. She then spent 64 cents on a pencil and 10 cents on a sweet. Ida keeps her diary in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents does Ida have now?
w10_T4_003789: A nursery raised 64 trays of tomato seedlings with 7 seedlings in each tray, in a greenhouse 20 metres long. Half of the seedlings were planted in the east field. Each seedling in the east field produced 6 tomatoes. The gardener added 50 tomatoes from a small side plot to the east field's harvest, and then threw away 51 tomatoes that had rotted. How many tomatoes were left from the east field's harvest?
w10_T4_003790: Kit had 61 cents in her money box. She added 71 cents that she found in the car and then 50 cents from her grandfather. Her brother paid back 49 cents he had borrowed. She then spent 224 cents on a comic book. Kit prefers to write her savings in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents are in her money box now?
w10_T4_003799: Teo's stationery stall had 124 pens, more than the 100 pens on Val's stall. A supplier brought Teo 44 more pens. Teo sold every pen for 7 cents. He spent 152 cents of the takings on a new display box. Val then paid him 46 cents she owed, and a customer left 55 cents as a tip. How many cents does Teo have now?
w10_T4_003800: In the morning, 210 cupcakes were shared equally among 5 stalls at the school fair, and a dozen parents helped set up. At the Oak stall, 18 cupcakes were sold before lunch. In the afternoon the Oak stall's remaining cupcakes were divided equally into 4 boxes, and 1 box was given to the head teacher. In the evening the head teacher ate 2 cupcakes from her box. How many cupcakes are left in the head teacher's box?
w10_T4_003805: In the morning, 8 vans left the parcel depot, which is 15 kilometres from the town centre, with 232 parcels in each van, and half of the drivers were new. By midday 860 parcels had been delivered. In the afternoon the vans collected 45 parcels from a shop and 47 from an office. In the evening they collected 70 parcels from a warehouse. How many parcels are in the vans now?
w10_T4_003812: Ana's garden pond held 24 goldfish, fewer than the 30 in Ben's pond. She bought 26 more fish for it. A heron then took 32 fish. Over the summer the fish bred until there were 8 times as many fish in the pond. In autumn Ana added 56 fish that Ben no longer wanted. She measures the pond's water in litres, though the pump is rated in kilolitres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many goldfish are in Ana's pond now?
w10_T4_003813: In the morning, the bike rental stand had 155 bikes, and 29 bikes were returned from the previous day. Before lunch 158 bikes were rented out. In the afternoon 3 bikes were returned. Renting a bike costs 5 dollars an hour. In the evening 14 bikes were rented out. How many bikes are at the stand now?
